projects.title: EmbeddedVision
projects.description: Developed firmware in C and a Python backend for a custom ESP32-S3N16R8 board that takes & processes pictures and uses modern AIs via api calls to interpret the image, and post understandings via SMS, Telegram, WhatsApp, Pushover, and to a home server. Modeled and 3D printed a case using Onshape to enclose the system and did all relevant wiring by hand. Currently working on developing a custom PCB to reduce form factor.

projects.title: CiscoScraper
projects.description: Built an agentic RAG system that turns Cisco IOS switch manuals into a semantically searchable knowledge base. An automated pipeline extracts commands from PDFs, generates LLM-powered summaries, and creates vector embeddings for 489 commands served through a FastAPI API with sub-second natural language search. Engineers query in plain English instead of memorizing exact command syntax. CiscoScraper achieved top 6-20 scores nationally on Cyberpatriot Packet Tracer challenges.

activity.title: First place in DEF CON CTF Quals! Super grateful to have been invited to play with SuperDiceCodeLovers and get to work alongside the best cyber talent in the world, and huge shoutout to Sebastian Dowell Swaraj Adhikari Eddie Guo Jamos Zhu for working with me on LiveCTF, which I'm super proud that we got first place in, with a final score of 1935 points! LiveCTF was a super interesting technical challenge, in which we were given a custom virtual machine running its own instruction set—essentially a 32-bit stack machine where code and stack share the same memory. We spent hours theorizing and drawing out different types of algorithms we wanted to implement on the 64KB bot, coming up with a new one for each phase of the game, where new rules were announced, which you had to figure out by reversing a new binary. We made an arena to simulate our bots locally, where we could use an ELO system and other metrics to continously iterate on our robots before deploying them into the competition environment, to generate a kind of evolutionary search to optimize on our bots. From King Von, the Linehunter, Pathfinder, DVD, and all the other bots we made this challenge was truly one to remember, and it really embodies the spirit of complex and non-standard problem solving, which is one of the most important skills you can build in life. Can't wait for Finals in August. Let's run it back! ...more
